summary: 13 of 15 confirmed starters, up from 12 last night - Garner is now set to start against Man Utd (Hackney a doubt with a knock, reversing yesterday's bench read) and Marmoush is upgraded to a confirmed starter now that Solanke's ankle injury has ended his competition for the Tottenham striker spot. Barcola remains expected on the bench for his Liverpool debut tonight and Doku is still out until around 13 September - the My squad tab should still treat those two as non-starters this gameweek despite their model numbers.

players.verdict: Undisputed number one, no fitness concerns
players.note: Everton's predicted XI for Sunday's home game against Manchester United has Pickford in goal as usual; he was ever-present in the league last season and there is no injury or rotation risk reported. No permitted outlet has published an XI for him, so this is not a stated start.

players.name: Barcola
players.verdict: Available but expected on the bench for his debut
players.note: Manager Andoni Iraola confirmed Barcola is available for Friday's away game at Ipswich after his GBP123m move from PSG, but was noncommittal on starting him given his lack of pre-season minutes; two independent predicted lineups have him on the bench behind Gakpo, Wirtz and Isak, with an impact-sub role the more likely outcome. That matches the model's very low 0.10 availability figure for now, well below what a GBP123m marquee arrival might otherwise suggest.

sources.title: 'I'm very happy' - Andoni Iraola on Bradley Barcola's arrival and availability for Ipswich

players.name: Doku
players.verdict: Out with calf injury, not back until 13 Sept
players.note: Doku aggravated a calf issue in the Community Shield and has already missed two Premier League games; manager Enzo Maresca has ruled him out for Saturday's game against Coventry too, with a return now pointing to 13 September against Manchester United rather than the 5 September date currently shown on the dashboard.

players.name: Garner
players.verdict: Now set to start vs Man Utd, ahead of a doubtful Hackney
players.note: Reversing yesterday's bench read: Sky Sports reports Garner is playing well enough to be in England call-up conversations and is set to start against his former club Man United on Sunday, with Hayden Hackney a doubt after picking up a knock. Model's 0.61 avail figure understates this.

sources.title: James Garner: Everton midfielder showing Manchester United what they're missing

runs.note: First deep pass for GW3 now the squad is final post-waivers. All 15 players researched club-by-club against confirmed and predicted lineups for this weekend's fixtures. Three status corrections against the model's own availability figures: Munoz and Bijol are safer starts than their low/mid figures suggest (Munoz confirmed over Aina at Forest, Bijol locked in after Rodon's 8-10 week hamstring injury), while Garner is a bench risk despite a moderate 0.61 figure - he did not actually start Everton's midweek Cup tie as earlier reported, he was a substitute, and Hackney is preferred for Sunday. Doku confirmed out until 13 September. Barcola confirmed bench for his Liverpool debut.
